The box indicates it is an AC/DC model with a 9V 6W solar panel.
Features listed on the box include oscillation, a USB mobile charger, and a safety metal grill.
The actual fan, solar panel, and bulb are not visible in the photo; only the packaging is shown.
A watermark from a classifieds site is visible on the image.

No bulb is visible on the box or in the photo

Video of the fan running on battery power
